description: This file implements a driver for accessing B53 switch registers via SPI interface. It defines functions for reading and writing various register sizes, manages SPI communication, and includes driver initialization and cleanup routines.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read_reg(struct spi_device * spi,u8 reg,u8 * val,unsigned len)
methods.description: Reads data from a specified register via SPI.

methods.name: int b53_spi_clear_status(struct spi_device * spi)
methods.description: Clears the SPI status register and waits for SPI readiness.

methods.name: int b53_spi_set_page(struct spi_device * spi,u8 page)
methods.description: Sets the register page for subsequent access.

methods.name: int b53_prepare_reg_access(struct spi_device * spi,u8 page)
methods.description: Prepares the SPI interface for register access by clearing status and setting page.

methods.name: int b53_spi_prepare_reg_read(struct spi_device * spi,u8 reg)
methods.description: Prepares the SPI interface for reading a specific register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * data,unsigned len)
methods.description: Reads a block of data from a specified register and page.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads 8 bits from a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads 16 bits from a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads 32 bits from a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads 48 bits from a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads 64 bits from a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes 8 bits to a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes 16 bits to a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes 32 bits to a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes 48 bits to a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes 64 bits to a specified register.

methods.name: int b53_spi_probe(struct spi_device * spi)
methods.description: Initializes the SPI driver when the device is probed.

methods.name: int b53_spi_remove(struct spi_device * spi)
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the device is removed.
